optimalSolutionPriorWork: This order minimizes the prior work penalty.

metadataDescription: Choose an item and enchantment levels to calculate a low-cost order for combining them on a Minecraft anvil.

ui.heroDescription: Choose an item and the enchantments you want. Find the order that uses the fewest levels at the anvil.
ui.itemHint: Use an unenchanted item that has never been worked on an anvil.
ui.enchantHint: Click a Roman numeral to select the level you want. Click it again to remove it.
ui.settingsHint: Choose what to minimize and which enchantments to allow.
ui.incompatibleHint: For special game versions or commands. These combinations are normally unavailable in Survival.
ui.manyHint: More enchantments can make the calculation much slower.
ui.emptyHint: Select your enchantments, then click Calculate.
ui.emptyBody: Choose an item, then select a level beside each enchantment you want. Click Calculate in the bar at the bottom to see the steps.
ui.resultHint: Use the left and right anvil slots exactly as shown, one step at a time.
ui.helpBody: Each previous anvil operation adds a penalty to future operations on that item or book. The default option minimizes the sum of the level costs across all steps.
ui.compatibleOnly: Selecting a conflicting enchantment automatically removes the previous one.
ui.guideOneBody: Choose the item you want to enchant. Beside each enchantment, click I–V to select its level. Click the same level again to remove that enchantment.
ui.guideTwoBody: Click Calculate in the bar at the bottom of the screen. With the default setting, the tool finds the order that spends the fewest levels in total.
ui.guideThreeBody: For each step, put the item or book shown on the left into the anvil’s left slot, and the one on the right into its right slot. Keep the result for the next step that uses it. Complete the steps in the order shown.
ui.guideNoteBody: The item and books must never have been worked on an anvil. Have a separate book ready at the selected level for each enchantment. The cost of combining lower-level books into those books is not included.
ui.conflictingGroupAllowed: Conflicting enchantment group — your settings allow incompatible choices.
ui.clearConfirmDescription: This will remove all {count} selected enchantments and any calculated result.
ui.selectItemToStart: Select an item to get started

about.title: About this project
about.origin: This site is a copy of Cal Henderson’s (iamcal) enchant-order project. All of the enchantment ordering logic and algorithms were taken from that project.
about.remake: We rebuilt this version entirely with AI to give it a better-looking, easier-to-use interface. Credit for the calculation logic belongs to the original project’s developers. Thanks to them for sharing their work.
